# gitmoap_provider_listing (Resource)

Edits the provider's marketplace page: its README, homepage and repository links, usage examples, and the categories and keywords it is found by. A field you leave out is unchanged and an explicit `null` clears it; categories, when sent, cannot be empty. Answers with the updated page. Only the publisher that owns the provider may edit it.

The token needs `provider_publishing:write` and `provider_catalog:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# How a pipeline provider you publish appears in the marketplace.
resource "gitmoap_provider_listing" "deploy" {
  provider_id    = "acme-deploy"
  categories     = ["deploy", "infrastructure"]
  keywords       = ["kubernetes", "helm"]
  homepage_url   = "https://acme.example.com/deploy"
  repository_url = "https://gitmoap.com/acme/deploy-provider"
  readme         = <<-EOT
    # acme-deploy
    Deploys a Helm chart to a Kubernetes cluster.
  EOT
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `provider_id` (String) Provider slug

### Optional

- `categories` (List of String) The categories to list the provider under, one to three. Replaces the current ones.
- `examples` (Attributes List) Usage examples, up to 10. Replaces the current ones; `[]` removes them all. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--examples))
- `homepage_url` (String)
- `keywords` (List of String) Search keywords, up to 10. Replaces the current ones; `[]` removes them all.
- `readme` (String)
- `repository_url` (String)

### Read-Only

- `install_count` (Number)
- `namespace_verified` (Boolean)
- `publisher` (Attributes) Who publishes a provider, and whether they are verified. Shown for providers gitmoap does not
build itself. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--publisher))
- `versions` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--versions))

<a id="nestedatt--examples"></a>
### Nested Schema for `examples`

Optional:

- `capability_ids` (List of String) The capabilities this example exercises; each must exist in some
published version of the provider (validated at write time).
- `description` (String) One- or two-sentence summary (<= 500 chars).
- `snippet` (String) A pipeline YAML/JSON fragment (<= 8 KB).
- `title` (String) Short heading (<= 120 chars).


<a id="nestedatt--publisher"></a>
### Nested Schema for `publisher`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String)
- `namespace` (String)
- `publisher_id` (String)
- `verification_method` (String) How a publisher's `verified` flag was earned. `Manual` is the platform-admin
grant (D3); `Dns` / `Github` are the self-service namespace-ownership proofs.
- `verification_target` (String)
- `verified` (Boolean)


<a id="nestedatt--versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `versions`

Read-Only:

- `changelog` (String)
- `lifecycle_state` (String) Lifecycle state of a published `ProviderVersionManifest`. `Active` is the
default; `Deprecated` still runs but the trigger-time validator surfaces a
warning; `Sunset` runs only inside its grace window, after which a trigger
referencing it fails validation.
- `published_at` (String)
- `published_by` (String)
- `sbom_available` (Boolean) Whether a software bill of materials (SBOM) is available for this version, as it is for
platform and verified providers.
- `signed` (Boolean)
- `version` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by its provider_id.
terraform import gitmoap_provider_listing.example "<provider_id>"
```
